title: Sure Strike Charters

services.name: Ice Fishing
services.desc: Sure Strike Charters is the Premier Lake Champlain fishing adventure. Our home port is Shelburne Shipyard which gives us easy access to some of the best fishing on Lake Champlain. With spectacular views of the Adirondack Mountains to the west and the Green Mountains to the east. You will enjoy fishing on a 28 1/2 foot Baha Sport fishermen or a 26 foot Baha Sport fishermen “reel” comfort. We usually fish for lake trout, landlock Atlantic salmon, Brown trout, Rainbow trout and Steelhead we can target other Species of fish too. Our 2 big boats goes in the water May,1st thru mid to late October. Our Casting and Jigging Boat Runs year round depending on Weather conditions Book now for the best

blurb: Sure Strike Charters is Vermont’s Premier Lake Champlain Fishing Charter . Our home port is Shelburne shipyard, which gives us easy access to some of the best fishing on Lake Champlain from Burlington across to Plattsburgh, New York. With spectacular views of the Adirondack Mountains in New York to the west and the Vermont Green Mountains to the east, you will enjoy fishing for Landlocked Atlantic Salmon, Lake Trout
